# Dentis - AI Voice Receptionist for Dental Practices

Dentis is an advanced, voice-first SaaS platform designed to automate reception and appointment scheduling for dental practices using ultra-realistic AI voice agents.

## Core Information
- **Landing Page:** https://dentis.rmstudio.app
- **Developer/Founder:** Riccardo Modena (RM Studio)
- **Target Audience:** B2B, Dental Clinics, Dentists, Medical practices.
- **Core Agent Name:** Serena (warm, empathetic, native Italian voice).

## Product Offerings & Pricing
- **Free Trial:** 7-day cardless free trial (full features).
- **Serena Starter (€79/mo):** Active strictly out-of-hours (nights, weekends). Email appt notifications.
- **Serena PRO (€149/mo):** 24/7 coverage, emergency triage, Google Calendar sync, automated WhatsApp & Email reminders.
- **Clinic Elite (€299/mo):** Multi-location, multi-calendar support, dedicated SLA.

## System Architecture
- **Voice Engine:** Vapi (ElevenLabs text-to-speech + Deepgram transcription).
- **Database:** Supabase (Auth, Postgres).
- **Automations:** n8n (Stripe integration, automated reminders, post-call sync).
- **WhatsApp Gateway:** OpenWA (Self-hosted on Oracle Cloud VPS).
- **Calendar Integration:** Native Google Calendar tools. No dental legacy software integration required (drag-and-drop buffer model).
